vectors.notes: G4 routed weighted sum of A7 and A3: hard switch at p > 0.5; A7 weight 0.9 for buildings, 0.2 for objects, picked from the grid by mean hit@10 over the scored tune halves. Type guess: logistic regression on A7 (penalty 0.1), trained on 12980 gallery images, 826 query entities left out; held-out balanced accuracy 98.7%; right on tune queries: T1 98.6% of 138, T3 100.0% of 99, T5 99.8% of 443, T8 99.6% of 232. Two-fold check, hit@10 with weights picked on the other fold: G4 T1 50.7, T3 85.9, T5 61.2; G1 on the same grid T1 46.4, T3 88.9, T5 53.0. T8 entry: cut-off per guessed type (confidence = rank among in-index confidences of the same type). With one cut-off on the raw routed cosines: wrong but confident 67.2% [59.9, 74.1], matched at 5% wrong 7.9% [5.7, 10.8]
